## Wayfare Forms
Receives both forms on the Wayfare site.

**Before activating:** replace YOUR_MAILING_ADDRESS in both Build email code nodes (domain and Telegram chat ID are already set), and pick credentials on: Save submission (Postgres), Run PageSpeed audit (Query Auth, name `key`), both Send nodes (Header Auth, name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <SendGrid key>`), both Telegram nodes.

Bots and bad input stop at *Real submission?*
